name: Saimin Class ~Joshi Zen'in, Shiranai Uchi ni Ninshin Shitemashita~
original_name: 催眠クラス　～女子全員、知らないうちに妊娠してました～
source:
I practiced hypnosis as a child. When I remembered it, I used it on everyone in the class! No matter how insane the erotic lesson is, it is “natural” because it is hypnosis!

Using hypnosis, my school life begins, where every day is an erotic lesson!
